description: Harness-neutral discovery catalog for Video Summary Accuracy Analyzer workflow skills. Paths are relative to the analyzer project root (tools/video-summary-accuracy-analyzer).

skills.name: video-summary-accuracy
skills.description: Evaluate a generated video summary against a reference supplied as pasted text, one combined .md/.txt file, or two separate .md/.txt files; report factual consistency, MENLI, semantic similarity, BERTScore, ROUGE, and temporal coherence with an evidence-based verdict.
triggers: evaluate pasted reference and generated summaries
